name: James Prindle

death.date: 9 Dec 1800 (Barbour index; Prindle Genealogy and FamilySearch say 9 Nov 1800)

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Church register: 'Married James Prindle & Anar Turner both of Newtown Jan 22' [1759].

bioAdditions: Two Newtown records attached to his FamilySearch profile can now be cited directly. The Newtown church marriage register records 'James Prindle & Anar Turner both of Newtown' married on 22 January 1759 (S1), matching the Prindle Genealogy. The Barbour Collection slip abstracted from Newtown Vital Records vol. 2 p.172 reads 'PRINDLE, James, d. Dec. 9, 1800' (S2) - December, where the Prindle Genealogy and FamilySearch have 9 November. The 1759 marriage date means that two of the five children FamilySearch assigns to him and Anar (James c.1754 and David 1757) were born before the marriage; they could only be his by an unrecorded earlier wife, or are misattributed. Samuel (c.1767) remains a possible son but is not documented as such.
